title: Percy's Flying Mission
legal: Prototype for RAF Museum London, ages 4–8. Percy is a made-up character. Drawings are simple and not accurate. Aircraft locations were checked on public sources in November 2026; route, sign places, viewing points and all facts must be checked by Museum staff before use. Do not touch the aircraft or climb barriers. Children must stay with their grown-up.

intro: Hello! I am Percy the penguin.
Penguins can't fly... but I really, really want to!
The RAF has been flying for over 100 years. Will you help me learn how they do it?
text.introGrown: Go through the hangars in order, 1 to 6. In each hangar, find at least one aircraft to win a stamp. Find all three for a gold stamp. Please help with reading and stay behind the barriers.
text.mapHelp: Visit the hangars in order. Find at least one aircraft in each hangar to get a stamp.
text.mapDone: You got a stamp from every hangar! Now let's design my plane.
signHelp: Look for my sign in this hangar.
What picture is on it? Tap the same picture.
text.signWrong: Not that one. Look at the sign again!
text.pickAircraft: Which aircraft will you find? Find one to get a stamp. Find all three for a gold stamp!
text.wrong: Good try! Look at the real one again 👀
text.showAnswer: Here is a clue: try the green one!
finaleStory: I can't fly with my flippers...
...but I CAN fly in a plane!
Will you design a plane for me?
text.certLine: helped Percy learn to fly through the RAF story.

finale.label: Hangar 1
finale.title: Design Percy's plane
finale.grown: Hangar 1 also has a real "Design your own plane" activity in First to the Future.
